page: Microsoft Azure E96-48ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the Edsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core. It also includes 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across memory and computational tasks. The server achieved a strong memory bandwidth read-only small block speed of 3723.24 GB/sec and a large block read speed of 234.94 GB/sec, though large block write bandwidth is average at 84.9 GB/sec. CPU performance is highlighted by a strong Passmark CPU score of 63798.65 and a top-tier Geekbench image processing score of 19373.0. Additionally, the processor's support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) contributes to strong performance in extended instructions and cryptography.

For database and transactional workloads, the server demonstrates high efficiency, executing 67.4 million Redis SET operations per second and scoring 24034.71 on Passmark database operations. Large-scale language model prompt processing is strong, reaching 27.41 tokens/sec for a 70B model, though text generation speeds remain average. This hardware profile offers high resource density, making it qualitatively cost-effective for memory-heavy enterprise applications without the overhead of dedicated GPU hardware. It is highly suited for large relational databases, in-memory caching, data analytics, and enterprise software compilation.
